rubric.finding: Purdue GIS FID 798 explicitly identifies Delta Sigma Phi at 341 Northwestern Avenue; the 2026 Street View and chapter address corroborate it.
The documented 22 wall-edge vertices match the projected GIS ring within 8.64e-7 m. The ring is used instead of conflicting GIS area/length attributes.
The local frame and proposed centroid (357.740058, -73.829742) m are documented. The master placement marker still needs coordinator integration and validation.
The steep dark roof, cross-gable, and dormers correspond to the visible 2026 reference. Some overall roof/elevation proportions and rear wing geometry are inferred from limited views.

Brick facade, upper windows, arched lower openings, entry, and steps provide useful architectural character. The facade is strongly repetitive and the exact distribution of openings/entry details is not fully established by the available oblique Street View.
Procedural buff-brown brick, slate shingles, limestone trim, window glass, foundation, door, and iron materials are distinct and portable. No external image or library dependencies are required.
No interior is modeled. The evidence package reports that no reliable floor plan was found; this is a disclosed omission, though it does not fulfill the earlier interior-detail aspiration.

Independent Blender fresh-open passed with stable scene/collection, 164 mesh objects, 8 materials, no external image dependencies, and no linked libraries. Source dates, CRS, transform, uncertainty, and limitations are documented.

limitations: No reliable floor plan or interior geometry.
